purpose: Define mandatory, rights-centered, non-retaliatory protocols for receiving, processing, investigating, and resolving civilian complaints within the Munisible Task Force.

intake_channels.description: Approved channels civilians may use to file complaints safely and confidentially.

intake_processing.description: Protocols governing how complaints are received, validated, and logged.

protocols.name: Immediate Audit Trail Entry
protocols.action: All complaints must be logged with timestamp, channel, and hash anchoring.

protocols.name: Retaliation Shield Activation
protocols.action: Automatically activate retaliation monitoring for all involved civilians.

protocols.name: Accessibility Verification
protocols.action: Ensure the complaint is readable, complete, and accessible for review.

investigation_protocols.description: Standards for neutral, rights-centered investigation of civilian complaints.

protocols.name: Neutral Investigator Assignment
protocols.action: Assign an investigator with no conflict of interest or prior involvement.

protocols.name: Evidence Integrity Review
protocols.action: Review documentation, telemetry, and audit trails for anomalies.

protocols.name: Civilian Safety Check
protocols.action: Assess whether the complainant requires additional protections or accommodations.

resolution_standards.description: Requirements for resolving complaints ethically, transparently, and non-punitively.

protocols.name: Transparent Findings Report
protocols.action: Produce a clear, accessible summary of findings for the civilian.

protocols.name: Corrective Action Directive
protocols.action: Issue corrective actions when misconduct or harm is confirmed.

protocols.name: Public Accountability Sync
protocols.action: Publish non-sensitive resolution data to public dashboards.

retaliation_prevention.description: Protocols ensuring civilians are protected from retaliation after filing complaints.

protocols.name: Continuous Telemetry Monitoring
protocols.action: Monitor for retaliation indicators across municipal systems.

protocols.name: Automatic Ethics Review Trigger
protocols.action: Any retaliation signal triggers immediate Ethics Division review.

protocols.name: Civilian Safety Outreach
protocols.action: Contact the civilian to ensure safety and provide support resources.

kernel_dependencies.identity_kernel: Required for actor verification, authority classification, and documentation anchoring.
kernel_dependencies.telemetry_kernel: Required for retaliation detection, pattern-of-practice analysis, and risk scoring.
kernel_dependencies.ethics_kernel: Required for rights-impact evaluation and non-punitive investigation logic.
